annotation.title_clean: H.R. 2864 — To amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to provide for the addition of certain equipment and services produced or provided by DJI Technologies to the list of covered communications equipment or services published under such Act, and for other purposes
annotation.title_en: H.R. 2864 — To amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to add DJI Technologies equipment and services to the covered communications equipment list (Countering CCP Drones Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. House of Representatives (Rep. Stefanik; Rep. Gallagher)
named_instruments_referenced: Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019
annotation.summary_en: H.R. 2864, introduced in the 118th Congress on 25 April 2023 by Reps. Stefanik and Gallagher and referred to the House Energy and Commerce Committee, would amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019. It would add equipment and services from the Chinese drone maker DJI Technologies to the FCC's list of covered communications equipment, citing national security.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 (47 U.S.C. 1601)
Adds DJI Technologies equipment and services to the list of covered communications equipment or services
Effectively restricts FCC authorization and use of DJI drones in US communications networks
Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce
